technical_and_design_decisions: Use Maven as the build tool for the project, as it is standard in the Spring ecosystem.
Implement the Spark Streaming processors (U5) as independent, self-contained Java/Scala classes with clear interfaces.
Use Apache Pig's standard scripting API to create the reference sample (U2).
For the CI environment (U4), use AWS CloudFormation or similar IaC to provision a standardized Windows EC2 image.
Leverage Spring's existing test infrastructure and JUnit for unit and integration testing.
The migration support (U1) will involve updating core framework APIs, providing migration documentation, and ensuring backward compatibility via deprecation.
assumptions: As the primary developer, I have full knowledge of the existing Spring XD 1.0 codebase, build system, and architecture.
The development environment (IDE, local JDK 17+) is already set up and functional.
Access to the project's source code repository (e.g., Git) and CI system (e.g., Jenkins) is available.
The target dependencies (Kafka SI GA, SHDP GA) are publicly available and their APIs are documented.
For the Windows build (U3) and CI (U4), I assume access to a Windows machine (physical or virtual) for initial testing and debugging.
No significant changes to the core Spring Framework (6.0+) or Java version are required for this incremental work.
The effort estimates include time for code writing, local unit testing, and peer review but not extensive system-wide performance or load testing.

activities.activity_description: Analyze changes between XD 1.0 and 1.1, update core APIs, create/update migration guide, and implement compatibility layer or deprecation warnings to help users port custom modules (U1).
Develop a complete, runnable sample Pig job/script within the XD ecosystem, including necessary configuration and documentation (U2).
Modify Maven POMs, shell scripts (or create PowerShell equivalents), and build documentation to ensure the project compiles and packages successfully on a Windows machine (U3).
Provision a Windows EC2 AMI with required tools, write/modify test runner scripts to execute the acceptance test suite on Windows, and integrate this into the CI pipeline (U4).
Design and implement the core Spark Streaming data processor modules in Java (using Java 8+ lambdas) and Scala, including configuration, and basic unit tests (U5).
Locate the PDF reference guide source (e.g., Asciidoc), update the copyright notice from 2014 to 2015, and regenerate the PDF (U6).

activities.activity_name: Upgrade Kafka SI to GA Release
activities.activity_description: Backport XD-specific Kafka changes to the relevant Spring Integration module, update Maven dependencies to the GA version, adjust any configuration or API changes, and run existing Kafka-related tests (U7).

activities.activity_name: Upgrade Spring Hadoop (SHDP) to GA Release
activities.activity_description: Update Maven dependencies to the SHDP GA version, assess and apply any necessary API or configuration changes required for compatibility, and test Hadoop-related components (U8).
